value.rationale: For a canonical natural interpolation between the cube and octahedron, including the regular rhombic dodecahedron, the largest contained tetrahedron has a fully explicit sharp all-real-parameter determinant profile with a nontrivial algebraic switch strictly before the regular shape. The theorem also supplies a unique sharp minimized normalized largest-simplex volume ratio and classifies all optimizers in the 14-vertex chamber, including ruling out continuous nonvertex families. These are substantive complete geometric invariants and a motivated phase-boundary phenomenon.
